english: The financial bank has money.
The boat reaches the river bank.
The light is bright.
The package is light in weight.
The animal mouse runs.
A person presses a keyboard key.
A person uses their door key to open a door.
expression: PARTIAL(core=AND(left=HAS(owner=PERSON, item=KEY_LOCK), right=DO(actor=PERSON, action=OPEN, object=DOOR)), missing=RAW(text="the key is used as the instrument that opens the door"))
gap: The instrument/means-of-action role and key identity across both clauses are unrepresented.

english: The person had almost left when an interruption made them reconsider.
expression: RAW(text="The person had almost left when an interruption made them reconsider.")
gap: Near-completion aspect, interruption and revised intention remain unmodeled.

english: A biological cell divides.
An electric cell has stored energy.
A device charges an electric cell.
A sensor detects a signal.
If the gas is heated, the gas expands.
The instrument may fail.
The 95% confidence interval excludes zero.
expression: PARTIAL(core=IS(subject=INTERVAL, property=CONFIDENCE_INTERVAL), missing=RAW(text="the confidence level is 95% and zero is outside the interval"))
gap: Numerical confidence level, interval membership and coverage assumptions are absent.

english: The phase transition has a discontinuity in the first derivative of free energy.
expression: RAW(text="The phase transition has a discontinuity in the first derivative of free energy.")
gap: Derivative order, mathematical continuity and thermodynamic model are unrepresented.

english: Every number equals itself.
At least one integer is greater than zero.
Not every integer is positive.
There is an integer below zero.
Two is less than three.
No integer is both positive and negative.
expression: NOT(claim=EXISTS(var=N, domain=INTEGER, claim=AND(left=IS(subject=REF(var=N), property=POSITIVE), right=IS(subject=REF(var=N), property=NEGATIVE))))

english: The function is continuous at every point in its domain.
expression: PARTIAL(core=FORALL(var=X, domain=DOMAIN, claim=IS(subject=FUNCTION, property=CONTINUOUS)), missing=RAW(text="continuity must be evaluated at the bound point X within its topology"))
gap: Continuity is not linked to the bound point or the domain topology.

english: The sequence converges uniformly on every compact subset.
expression: RAW(text="The sequence converges uniformly on every compact subset.")
gap: Uniform convergence, compactness and subset ranges are unrepresented.

english: The computer mouse moves the cursor.
A user presses a keyboard key.
A user has a security credential key.
A statistical model predicts data.
A program checks a file before deleting the file.
expression: BEFORE(earlier=DO(actor=PROGRAM, action=CHECK, object=FILE), later=DO(actor=PROGRAM, action=DELETE, object=FILE))

english: The server may fail.
A server sends a notification to one particular user.
expression: PARTIAL(core=DO(actor=SERVER, action=SEND, object=NOTIFICATION), missing=RAW(text="the notification has a particular intended recipient"))
gap: A recipient role and identity are not provided by DO.

english: A retry mechanism guarantees exactly-once execution despite concurrent network failures.
expression: RAW(text="A retry mechanism guarantees exactly-once execution despite concurrent network failures.")
gap: Concurrency, failure models and exactly-once guarantees are unrepresented.

english: A financial bank lends money.
A court protects a legal right.
A map marks the rightward direction.
A store charges a fee.
A policy may harm a community.
Some people have land.
A law applies to everyone except minors.
expression: PARTIAL(core=DO(actor=LAW, action=APPLY, object=PERSON), missing=RAW(text="universal scope excluding minors"))
gap: The universal domain, its minor exclusion set and applicability scope are not modeled.

english: A price ceiling reallocates scarcity costs across heterogeneous consumers.
expression: RAW(text="A price ceiling reallocates scarcity costs across heterogeneous consumers.")
gap: Distributional mechanism and differentiated participant attributes are absent.

english: A physical model represents a building.
A statistical model predicts observations.
An expert says that a report is false.
An agent may believe a claim that is false.
Every researcher believes the same claim.
An observer knows that an instrument measures a system.
Two independent pieces of evidence support the claim.
expression: PARTIAL(core=IS(subject=CLAIM, property=SUPPORTED), missing=RAW(text="support comes from two distinct independent evidence items"))
gap: Evidence identity, cardinality and independence are unrepresented.

english: The absence of evidence reduces posterior probability without logically proving falsity.
expression: RAW(text="The absence of evidence reduces posterior probability without logically proving falsity.")
gap: Bayesian updating and non-entailment of falsity require richer forms.
